listingTitle: Shampoo and Conditioner Dispenser - Wall-Mounted 3-Chamber Shower Soap Dispenser, No-Drill, 1200ML Capacity, for Bathroom & Hotel (black-3-pack)
listingLines: Larger Liquid Outlet:Our shampoo and conditioner dispenser features oversized buttons, allowing for a more efficient and smoother experience compared to standard shower soap dispensers. Dispenses the ideal amount with one press, reducing the need for repeated pressing and saving soap. Perfect for all types of liquids, especially thicker ones like conditioners!

Upgraded Durable Material:This wall-mounted shower soap dispenser is made from ultra-hard ABS material, ensuring it's environmentally friendly, wear-resistant, and waterproof. It features clearly labeled compartments for shampoo, conditioner, and body wash for easy identification. The dispenser is designed with an easy-press, leak-proof pump that guarantees longevity, lasting up to 10 years withstanding over 300,000 presses.

1200ML Large Capacity: Each chamber holds 400ML (14.85 oz) of liquid, minimizing the need for frequent refills. The visual window allows you to monitor the remaining liquid easily, while the wide-opening refillable bottles can be removed for cleaning and refilling. The top lock design helps manage your supplies efficiently.

Versatile Mounting:Whether you're installing it in a bathroom, hotel, or kitchen, this dispenser is designed to meet your needs. The no-drill option is especially useful for renters or those who prefer not to damage their walls.

Two Installation Methods: We offer two options for installation - choose between our no-drill 3-chamber shower dispenser or the drill-required 3-chamber shower dispenser. Follow the provided installation manual or watch our main image video for a hassle-free setup.
summary: This wall-mounted 3-chamber dispenser organizes shampoo, conditioner, and body wash to reduce shower bottle clutter. It features oversized buttons and a 1200ML total capacity to provide a smoother experience with fewer refills.
highlights: Three 400ML chambers with clearly labeled compartments for easy identification
Oversized buttons designed to dispense thick liquids like conditioner with one press
Constructed from ultra-hard ABS material that is waterproof and wear-resistant

Hotel showers requiring a high-capacity, lockable soap management system

Coordinate the matte black finish with other black hardware like faucets or towel racks for a cohesive aesthetic.

Check the listing to confirm if your specific wall surface is compatible with the no-drill installation method.
Verify that the black color matches your existing bathroom fixtures and decor.

faq.question: How much liquid does each individual chamber hold?
faq.answer: Each of the three chambers holds 400ML (14.85 oz) of liquid, providing a total capacity of 1200ML for the entire unit.

faq.question: Can this dispenser handle thick liquids like heavy hair conditioner?
faq.answer: Yes, the oversized buttons and pump are specifically designed to work with all types of liquids, especially thicker ones like conditioners.

faq.answer: The leak-proof pump is designed for longevity, lasting up to 10 years and withstanding over 300,000 presses.
